_comment: The orchestrator suite, and the reads each of its test files makes outside genesis/orchestrator (E11).
suite-run.mjs runs it from this list, in these groups, in this order; package.json test runs `node suite-run.mjs all`.
A file with reads is a named file. The orchestrator gate keys on the union of these reads with genesis/orchestrator
(gate-input-audit.mjs suiteReadSet) and runs the named files in a view holding only those bytes (suite-run.mjs buildView),
so a read the list does not declare is absent there and the test fails rather than reading unkeyed bytes.
A read is an exact path, a directory prefix, a submodule gitlink path (never a path inside one), or a **/<name> walk;
inside a declared submodule the view holds the files matching a declared **/<name> walk, at the pinned commit.
A submodule that .gitmodules declares `update = none` contributes its pin to the key and nothing to the view: its directory is empty there, as in a fresh clone, on every device.
modules names the packages the view's node_modules holds: their closure is checked against pnpm-lock.yaml, copied, and hashed into the key.
tools names a probe (argv) for each program the named files run; each runs with the view's environment and must exit 0, or the run is refused before any test starts.
allowedSkips names each skipped test the named half may report ({file, test, reason}); any other skip turns it red.
A file with tree is keyed on the whole commit tree: it runs in the orchestrator-tree gate project, with its reason.
notInSuite names the test files under genesis/orchestrator that no orchestrator recipe runs, with the reason.
